name: Zijin Gold International Company Limited
summary: Zijin Gold International Company Limited explores, mines, processes, smelts, refines and sells gold and other minerals, with gold bullion, alloy and concentrate as principal products. Operations are in Ghana, Kazakhstan, Colombia, Guyana, Western Australia, Papua New Guinea and Kyrgyzstan, among other locations. Founded in 2000 and based in Kowloon, it was previously Jinfeng (HK) International Mining and is owned by Gold Mountains (Hong Kong) International Mining.
